title: Chain of Responsibility Middleware — Runnable Implementations
title_es: Middleware Chain of Responsibility — Implementaciones ejecutables
description: Runnable middleware pipeline in TypeScript and JavaScript: class-based handler chain (auth, rate limit, validation, logging) plus an Express/Koa-style compose() dispatch loop with short-circuit and double-next guard.
description_es: Pipeline de middleware ejecutable en TypeScript y JavaScript: cadena de handlers basada en clases (auth, rate limit, validación, logging) más un dispatch estilo Express/Koa con cortocircuito y guarda de double-next.
